facts.text: Under the UVM Promise, Vermont students with family adjusted gross income of $100,000 or less receive grant aid covering full tuition and comprehensive fees.

sources.title: UVM Promise | The University of Vermont
sources.quote: whose parents' adjusted gross income (AGI) is $100,000 or less with typical assets, can have their Federal, state, and other secured grants and scholarships supplemented by UVM to cover their tuition and comprehensive fee.

facts.text: Under the UVM Promise, admitted Vermont undergraduate students with parental adjusted gross income of $100,000 or less pay zero tuition and comprehensive fees.

sources.title: UVM Promise | The University of Vermont
sources.quote: whose parents' adjusted gross income (AGI) is $100,000 or less with typical assets, can have their Federal, state, and other secured grants and scholarships supplemented by UVM to cover their tuition and comprehensive fee.
